audit.whatIsWrong: Three places tell you to sidestep Tangle-Barbs 'behind minions'. That is backwards.
audit.why: Riot's text: the tangle 'damages and roots everything it passes through', and 'if the tangle kills an enemy or passes through a champion, it becomes larger, faster, and roots for longer'. Standing behind the wave feeds it — it passes through minions and reaches you upgraded.
audit.corrected: Dodge laterally, out of the line, not behind minions.

audit.whatIsWrong: 2+ items was scored Lucian in both layers while whys[6] and spikes[3] both say Neeko out-scales and wins the duel outright.
audit.why: Same page answered 'who wins late' two different ways. The packet chart also gives stage 7 to Neeko.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side and win[6] -> Neeko as a matched pair; Level 6 moved from 'Skill' to Lucian, which is what whys[4], spikes[2] and the packet chart all say.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why described The Culling generically and never named the thing that decides Level 6.
audit.why: Pop Blossom (120/105/90s) is a knock-up plus stun and the only thing in her kit that breaks The Culling's channel; its preparation is hidden while she is disguised, so the tell may not be there.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Cull her, but only with Pop Blossom down.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] promised a 'fifteen-second invitation' off a missed Tangle-Barbs.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 — the invented 15s number overstates the window by a quarter.

The packet suspectName 'Save Relentless Pursuit' is a false positive — that is Lucian's real E name. The clone/disguise handling in early is accurate: Inherent Glamour breaks on casting damaging spells or on taking damage equal to the disguise's healthbar.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Neeko out-scales you: Tangle-Barbs root into Blooming Burst and a 90s Pop Blossom bursts your low base HP outright.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: The Culling deletes a squishy Neeko — hold it until Pop Blossom is down so the stun can't break it.

edits.before: The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs roots through minions and grows if it clips one — sidestep sideways, never hide behind the wave.

edits.before: Neeko burns Tangle-Barbs (Root) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 — when she misses it, that window is yours.

edits.before: That is Neeko’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Her Q blooms a second time at 800 range — poke back only once Tangle-Barbs misses.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — 12s at rank 1, roots through minions and upgrades on contact, so dodge sideways. It governs your forward steps. - E dash spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold R until Pop Blossom is spent.

notes: 13 games behind 61.54%, so the win rate carries little weight; the chart edits are driven by the page contradicting itself, not by the rate. Pop Blossom's preparation being hidden while disguised is stated in Riot's own text and is written into the Level 6 line. Nothing was asserted about whether Cleanse, QSS or tenacity affect Pop Blossom's stun or Tangle-Barbs' root — the kits do not say, and I did not guess.
